propositions: rebar comment silently stores flag-like tokens (e.g. '--body-file', '--body') as the comment body instead of rejecting them, destroying the intended content while exiting 0
The same footgun affects other positional-body commands (create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) allowing silent data loss across the CLI surface
A secondary bug compounds the loss: surplus positional arguments are discarded by args[:min_args] slicing, so 'rebar comment <id> --body-file path' loses the body twice and still exits 0
Users reach for --body-file idiomatically for long bodies, suggesting the interface is intuitive but unsupported, leaving them vulnerable to silent truncation

The loss is undetectable by exit code, stderr, or comment count checks, only surfacing when content is actually read, breaking the documented expectation that the ticket store is a durable shared trail
